claims.text: PARENT correlates with human judgments better than existing text generation metrics like BLEU and ROUGE.
PARENT shows higher correlation with human ratings across grammaticality, fluency, and semantics compared to other metrics.
PARENT's inclusion of source tables improves its correlation with human judgments, particularly for semantic fidelity.
